name: loremfile

tools.name: list_fixtures
tools.description: One page of the published sample files, filtered by format, tag and size. Reads the published manifest over the network. Each comes with its URL and a description of what it is for. `total` counts every match and `next_offset` fetches the next page; it is null on the last.

format.description: Formats to include, any of, e.g. ["pdf", "png"].

tag.description: Tags to include, any of, e.g. ["encrypted"].

max_bytes.description: Only files of at most this size.

limit.description: Fixtures per page, 50 unless set, at most 250.

tools.name: describe_fixture
tools.description: The published manifest entry for one fixture: its URL, MIME type, size, SHA-256, tags, description and measured properties. Reads the published manifest over the network. Metadata only; fetch the URL for the file.

tools.name: verify_file
tools.description: Hash a file on this machine and compare it with the published SHA-256 and size of a fixture. Reads the published manifest over the network. `status` is ok, changed or missing. The file is read only to hash it.

file.description: The local file: absolute, or relative to where the server was started.

instructions: CC0 sample files and test fixtures from loremfile.dev, each at a stable URL. Use list_fixtures to find one, describe_fixture for its size, hash and measured properties, and verify_file to check a copy on disk. The tools return URLs, never file contents.
